integrity: Reproducible integer enumeration and independent exact union-find checks for the eight-vertex witness; analytical Bernstein expansion for every retention probability. All assessment is self-review; no independent scientific audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact small-tree classification through eight vertices; equal-sized habitat patches, independent and identically distributed vertex survival, largest-component order, and identical degree multisets. Does not establish optimality for larger tree orders or for weighted, dependent, directed, or non-tree networks. The historical-literature comparison remains subject to unlocated equivalents.
title: Eight habitat patches are the sharp threshold for a degree-matched largest-fragment reversal
